title: Chile — Estallido Social 2019
description: Protestas masivas iniciadas el 18-Oct-2019 por alza de tarifa metro. 1.2M personas marcharon el 25-Oct. Polarización política se duplicó.
sources: CEP Survey #85 (Nov-2019): aprobación presidencial cayó de 52% a 14%
Twitter analysis: Garretón et al. (2021) — polarización en RRSS
data_notes: P represents polarization_index (units: index). Series reconstructed from published research sources (empirical_estimated). Observation operator H: std(opinion) / 1.0. At Tier 1 (< 500 observations), only aggregate parameters can be calibrated against this case; see docs/validation/PROMPT_CALIBRACION_EQUIPO_AGENTES.md.
observation_operator_description: Polarization index: P tracks opinion distribution spread during social upheaval. Observation operator H: std(opinion_dimension) normalized by half-range.
